name: discard_tracks
title: Discard tracks
description: Delete the media files of the given tracks from a meeting's bundle to reclaim disk space. Each discarded track keeps its manifest record with discarded=true and its recorded sha256 / duration, so idempotent regeneration can still verify what the existing transcripts were made from — but the media itself cannot be recovered. mic / system can only be discarded after their transcription artifact (transcripts/own-mic / transcripts/own-system) exists (invalid_argument otherwise); screen can be discarded at any time. Re-discarding an already-discarded track is a no-op. Returns the full track map after the operation. `scope` is the scope selector (default deny: a scoped meeting needs its scope in the request). `request_id` is the client-generated idempotency key: repeating the call returns the original result. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: not_found (unknown meeting, or the meeting has no such track), scope_denied (the request does not cover the meeting's scope), busy (the meeting is still recording, or a job is queued / running for it), invalid_argument (mic / system requested before its transcript exists), internal.

scope.description: Omitted = unscoped meetings only. One name = that scope + unscoped. Array of 2+ names = cross-scope lookup (audit-logged).

tracks.description: Full track map after the operation. Discarded tracks have discarded=true but keep their recorded sha256 / duration.
